content.short: PRBTest provides Solidity smart contract testing assertions and logging utilities.
content.description: PRBTest is a comprehensive collection of testing assertions and utilities for Solidity, designed to work smoothly with Foundry and Hardhat. Written by Paul Razvan Berg, PRBTest includes a Foundry Template and inherits most tests from forge-std, providing a solid baseline for Solidity testing. The project is open-source and encourages developers to contribute custom test assertions to expand the suite and tailor it to their contracts. By offering reusable checks and a clear testing structure, PRBTest helps improve test reliability and developer productivity for Solidity projects.
